Class StructureBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.StructureBuilder
public final class StructureBuilder extends Object
Builds a piece of a molecule from atom positions and bonds.

Atoms receive indices starting at zero, in the order you add them. Name important atoms with attachment(String, int) so you can connect pieces without tracking indices.

      public int addAtom(String element, double x, double y, double z)
      Adds an atom with the specified element symbol and 3D Cartesian coordinates.
      Parameters:
      element - the element symbol, such as C or O
      x - the x coordinate, in the structure's units
      y - the y coordinate, in the structure's units
      z - the z coordinate, in the structure's units
